The '''Malkite honor creed''' was a code of conduct amongst the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. It specifically forbade any Poisoner from killing a target using any tool other than those found in the [[Malkite poisoner's kit]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
